title: smoothtato
caption: Cuts Path of Exile's visual clutter with presets that keep combat cues readable.
workflow: Choose a preset, inspect which effect categories it removes and keep the important encounter cues. Saved configurations make the changes repeatable; restoring Original brings the visuals back.
benefit: Fewer particles competing with the thing about to kill you.
demo: Compare preset changes and generate a reversible configuration plan.
boundary: A public preset planner using authored asset categories. It does not patch game files or measure FPS.
